decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 10 July 2022 Time 12:41 2022 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 07 - 10 July 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 53), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The rear wing assembly and the setup of the suspension has been changed.
offence: Breach of Article 40.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The changed rear wing assembly is of a different specification from the one used during the Sprint. The part was replaced with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate as per article 40.3. As the rear wing assembly is a different specification and was changed whilst the car was in parc ferme and the suspension setup has also changed, the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane per article 40.9 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 40.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 77 Parc Ferme
